description.en: Indexes local PDFs and Zotero libraries into a SQLite knowledge base, retrieves with hybrid BM25 + vector search and cross-encoder reranking, and returns cited passages with section- and page-level provenance through ten kb_* tools (ingest, search, cited Q&A, Zotero import, DOI fetch, scope, stats, job status, dedup, clear).
description.zh: 把本地 PDF 与 Zotero 库索引进 SQLite 知识库，用 BM25 + 向量混合检索与交叉编码器精排，通过十个 kb_* 工具（入库、检索、带引用问答、Zotero 导入、DOI 补库、范围、统计、任务状态、去重、清库）返回带章节与页码出处的引用片段。
